implementationGate.dependency: repair2 fixture worker owns the fixture files; implementer/reviewer must re-read final files and record fresh hashes

corrections.contract: Final re-read/hash gate and exact intended per-variant methods; no stale hash is represented as final.
No-mod baseline plus three candidate smokes use module/type/config/self-exit witnesses and exact baseline-relative error allowlist.

deadline=5 begins at start; no state change after T+180, ready by T+210 before shutdown, model shutdown near T+240, self-exit bound T+420; 13 countdowns budget about 65 minutes: 1 fixture-free no-mod control, 3 candidate smokes, 5 valid-chain processes, and 4 bad write/read processes. The earlier 12/60 count excludes the mandatory control.
Every process, trigger, marker, profile, log set, port, and receipt is phase/run correlated; stale or unscoped material fails.

A canonical nonzero PID has four present blocks with at least one nonzero; zero-valued blocks are legitimate. All-zero seed PIDs defer canonicalization to the first same-v1 reload; partial means missing blocks, not a mixed zero/nonzero tuple, and valid clone-derived records must continue the canonical PID.
Exact schema/value/callback sets precede mutation; required saves follow mutation and ready and precede self-exit.
Snapshots follow self-exit/release, reject links/reparse points, prove sorted path/size/SHA256 equality, and rehash immutable sources.
storageAutoFix=0 is explicit; two valid controls are mandatory; CE-init/control failure preserves artifacts and stops without timer variation.

compile.errorPolicy: candidate-attributable or new-vs-control errors fail; allow only pre-recorded baseline diagnostics after narrow normalization of run-variable timestamp, PID, and profile-path prefixes; diagnostic message text, source-code stack locations, and count must then match exactly, while physical RPT line numbers are not compared

noModControl.commonBaseline: engine/CE/config baseline remains comparable to candidates; record exact fixture-free differences

oracle.canonicalPid: four present blocks with at least one nonzero seed block, else first same-v1 reload; zero-valued blocks are legitimate, partial means missing blocks, and changes/missing IDs fail

matrix.expect: prelaunch fresh storage root absent; after startup/CE, zero existing fixture objects while retaining that prelaunch proof; then 3 schema-1 records; labels/charges/positions; save after ready
exactly 3 schema-1 LOAD_OK; canonical PID continuity; no spawn
3 schema-1 migrations with locked=false then normal schema-2 saves
precondition exactly 3 schema-2 records with labels, charges, canonical PIDs, and locked=false; v2 has no omission getter/flag; mutate control-true only; normal saves
schema-2 false/false/true then immutable pre-bad snapshot
one omitted faulty locked write; both controls normal and later LOAD_OK

failurePolicy: Ordinary reloads require all three fixtures and fail on missing, extra, or duplicate records. Each bad-read requires both valid controls, records faulty presence or absence without prescribing either, and rejects unexpected or duplicate records. Any cutoff, CE-init, control, callback-order, ID, count, save, or snapshot failure preserves branch/receipts and stops that branch; no blind retry or timer variation.
